response.sql: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_avg_price FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS baseline_price FROM Products HAVING COUNT(unit_price) > 0), kept AS (SELECT t.type_avg_price FROM type_averages t CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE t.type_avg_price > b.baseline_price), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg_price) AS kept_mean_price FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.type_avg_price) AS avg_type_price, AVG(k.type_avg_price - b.baseline_price) AS avg_above_baseline, AVG(k.type_avg_price - m.kept_mean_price) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM baseline b CROSS JOIN kept_mean m LEFT JOIN kept k ON k.type_avg_price > m.kept_mean_price GROUP BY b.baseline_price, m.kept_mean_price;
